title: Establish fieldwork-api-core when patterns emerge from 2-3 API crates
description: After building fieldwork-api-mastodon + fieldwork-api-pixelfed (+ maybe lemmy), extract the common patterns into fieldwork-api-core. Candidates: auth middleware, pagination helpers, error response formatting, rate limiting, CORS, API versioning. Do NOT create this crate until at least 2 API crates exist and we can see what they actually share. Build first, abstract second.
